question: Describe a time you had to learn something new quickly. How did you approach it?
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates ability to adapt to new technologies or domains.
exampleAnswer: I was asked to integrate a payment gateway I had never used before, with a two-week deadline. Situation: I had no prior experience with payment APIs. I started with the official documentation, then built a small prototype to understand the flow. I consulted a colleague who had integrated a similar gateway. Result: I completed the integration in 10 days with full test coverage and zero production issues.
weakAnswerPitfalls: Over-reliance on others without personal effort
followUpQuestions: What resources do you use to learn new skills?
How do you balance learning with delivery?
What is something you learned recently?
